targets.material: Commercial POM Wonderful 100% pomegranate juice batches assayed in Singh et al.
targets.preparation: Chilled commercial juice; not whole-fruit or other-product equivalence

evidence.statement: The primary human study assayed ellagic acid and punicalagins in the administered juice matrix.

targets.limitations: Product and batch dependent. No urolithin A was detected in the juice; microbial conversion is variable. No whole-fruit quantity, ordinary-serving efficacy or brain benefit inferred.
